title: RE harness fixture: model document (v1)
description: Pure-data model shared verbatim by the reference and candidate runners. One file per fixture. BPMN fixtures carry the XML text plus the derived F1 canonical model; xyflow fixtures carry a flow graph; JointJS fixtures carry a graph JSON. No fixture encodes library calls.

xml.description: BPMN XML text (reference-native); present only for bpmn-xml-f1.

model.description: Canonical model: F1 (bpmn), flow graph (xyflow) or graph JSON (jointjs). Keys are compared after canonical sort.

pixelThreshold.description: Per-fixture pixel secondary threshold (SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY §5.3: fixed per fixture).
